- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The clock tower, known as "Old Joe," is the tallest freestanding clock tower in the world at 100 meters tall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The clock tower features a Neo-Venetian Gothic design characterized by pointed arches, cusped tracery, decorative stonework, and richly ornamental details.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The clock tower is constructed of red brick, a common building material in Victorian times, with ornately decorated brickwork and carved stone accents.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The clock tower has strong vertical lines emphasized by pointed arches, pilasters, and buttresses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The clock face is ornate, featuring gold numerals and hands against a black background, complemented by ornate wrought iron hands.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The clock tower houses an iconic bell known as "Big Joe," which has a deep, sonorous tone and is one of only two of its kind in the world.
